card.name: Digits inside phone numbers and codes
card.fires_on: Single digits or hyphens inside a phone number, such as a toll-free adverse-event line, or inside a numeric code like GS-331007, often after a leading 33 or 233. The pole is most negative in the middle of the number.

modes.label: Phone numbers
modes.description: Digits or hyphens in the middle of a toll-free or reporting phone number.

modes.label: Numeric codes
modes.description: A digit inside a compound or product code, or a ZIP code.
